notes.title: Update 1.02 - Added hands!
notes.content:
Hello! Due to community request, we have replaced the Vive and Oculus motion controllers with hands for added immersion.

Changes:

Added hands
Added animations when grabbing and when about to grab
When grabbing objects, your hands will always be visible (before the controllers would disappear when grabbing for visibility).
Redesigned oxygen meter as a watch on the hand.


Fixes:

Fixed bug where caustics texture would remain after the water is drained.


Again we thank you for the feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.01 - Wall Clipping and a few minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

Fixed wall clipping by window.

Fixed a minor sequence break with morse code puzzle. (no more lucky guessing)

Fixed bug where letters would stop on incorrect positions. 


Planned updates:

Replace controller models with hands.

Replace oxygen meter with a display on player's wrist.
